label: Webhook (Sync Gateway)
type: a configured HTTP callback (via sgw:webhook-filter) firing on document changes - posts a document whole or not at all (no field-level redaction). Trades off against sgw:changes-feed; the two pages sharing this trade-off share an identical opening paragraph and comparison table, evidence they were authored as a matched pair.
note: Carries an explicit security caution: a webhook posts application data, including potentially sensitive user data, to configured URLs.
